summary: Iteration 39 - Live Moderation & Snapshot Features - All 39 backend tests PASSED. Frontend moderation panel components verified. Mobile layout confirmed: chat flows below stage (no FAB needed). Live sessions end quickly in headless browser due to missing host heartbeat (expected behavior).
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND: GET /api/users/lookup - VERIFIED: q<2 chars returns [], q>=2 returns max 10 results with {user_id, name, avatar_url, handle}
BACKEND: GET /api/users/lookup?scope=subscribers - VERIFIED: Filters to active subscribers of requesting creator
BACKEND: POST /api/live/{id}/snapshot - VERIFIED: Host-only (403 for non-host), validates data:image/ prefix, stores preview_data_url
BACKEND: GET /api/live/active - VERIFIED: Returns preview_url field, does NOT include preview_data_url blob
BACKEND: GET /api/live/{id} - VERIFIED: Anonymous/non-host gets preview_url only; host gets both preview_url AND preview_data_url
BACKEND: GET /api/live/{id}/banned - VERIFIED: Host-only (403 for non-host), returns array with name/avatar/email
BACKEND: POST /api/live/{id}/banned/{user_id}/unban - VERIFIED: Host-only, removes from banned_users
BACKEND: GET /api/live/{id}/moderators - VERIFIED: Host-only, returns moderators with permission flags
BACKEND: POST /api/live/{id}/moderators - VERIFIED: Host-only, rejects self, upserts moderator with 6 permission flags
BACKEND: DELETE /api/live/{id}/moderators/{user_id} - VERIFIED: Host-only, removes moderator
BACKEND: POST /api/live/{id}/mute - VERIFIED: Host or mod with can_mute, sets muted_until timestamp
BACKEND: POST /api/live/{id}/chat - VERIFIED: Muted user gets 403 with detail.error='muted'
BACKEND: DELETE /api/live/{id}/chat/{message_id} - VERIFIED: Host or mod with can_delete_msg
BACKEND: POST /api/live/{id}/pin/{message_id} - VERIFIED: Host or mod with can_pin, toggles pinned_message_id
BACKEND: POST /api/live/{id}/kick - VERIFIED: Extended for moderators with can_kick/can_ban permissions
FRONTEND: LiveRoom.jsx - VERIFIED: Mobile layout uses grid with lg:col-span-8 (stage) + lg:col-span-4 (chat), chat flows below stage on mobile
FRONTEND: LiveModerationPanel.jsx - VERIFIED: Two tabs (Modérateurs/Bannis), debounced search, scope toggle, permission pills
FRONTEND: LiveHostStage.jsx - VERIFIED: 10s snapshot capture loop POSTs to /live/{id}/snapshot
FRONTEND: Live.jsx - VERIFIED: Uses preview_url for live cards, no Radio icon overlay
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 39 completed successfully. All new moderation endpoints working: /users/lookup, /live/{id}/snapshot, /live/{id}/banned, /live/{id}/moderators, /live/{id}/mute, /live/{id}/chat/{msg_id}, /live/{id}/pin/{msg_id}. Extended /kick endpoint accepts moderators with can_kick/can_ban. Mobile layout confirmed: chat panel flows below stage (col-span-12 on mobile, lg:col-span-4 on desktop). Live sessions end quickly in headless browser due to missing host heartbeat - this is expected backend reaper behavior. Lou AI assistant button at bottom-right does not conflict with chat since chat is inline (no FAB).

live_room_layout.mobile_chat_below_stage: VERIFIED via code review - lg:col-span-4 means full width on mobile
live_room_layout.no_fab_needed: VERIFIED - chat panel inline, not in drawer

notes.mobile_layout: Chat panel uses lg:col-span-4 which means on mobile (<1024px) it takes full width and flows below the stage. No FAB needed.
notes.live_session_timeout: Live sessions end quickly in headless browser because host heartbeat isn't sent. This is expected backend reaper behavior (ends sessions without heartbeat after ~60s).
notes.moderation_permissions: Six permissions: can_kick, can_ban, can_delete_msg, can_mute, can_pin, can_view_revenue. Default add: kick+ban+delete+mute=true, pin+revenue=false.
notes.snapshot_feature: Host captures JPEG snapshot every 10s and POSTs to /live/{id}/snapshot. Lobby shows preview_url (snapshot or avatar fallback).
